The '''father''' of the [[Dubravan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Nevana]] owed a large debt to the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Sarma]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. His daughter tried to clear his debt by selling Sarma the name and location of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who had destroyed the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] and was wanted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Rather than accede to Nevana's demands, however, Sarma turned her in to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dubrava/Legends|Dubrava]].<ref name="Vader's Quest" />
